from pathlib import Path
prog_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u091/system/state/workspace/programs')
prog_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for value in row:
            if value != 0:
                counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1
    marker = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == marker]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in points)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in points)
    shape = [(r - r0, c - c0) for r, c in points]
    sh = max(r for r, c in shape) + 1
    sw = max(c for r, c in shape) + 1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for top in range(h - sh + 1):
        for left in range(w - sw + 1):
            if all(grid[top + dr][left + dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:
                    out[top + dr][left + dc] = marker
    return out
'''
path=prog_dir/'task-6d3299de.py'
path.write_text(program)
